run_eval_checkpoints_main: run the main function to evaluate multiple model checkpoints via a matrix job submission
submit_job_with_checkpoints: submit a matrix job that runs a command template across multiple model checkpoints
poll_job_status: poll the matrix job status every 30 seconds until the job completes or fails
get_job_results: retrieve and print the results from a completed matrix job
format_command_template: format a command template string using checkpoint name and path variables
